input.text: A personal banker can waive no more than $25 for one account in a calendar year, or up to $50 with branch manager approval noted in the account. Customers may request a fee refund within 60 days of the statement date.

input.text: An operations manager must give a second approval for any outgoing wire above $50,000.

Outgoing consumer and small business wire requests received after 3:00 PM Central are processed the next business day.

input.text: Callbacks are completed by a wire specialist, never by the employee who took the request. Call the customer back at a phone number already on file before releasing any outgoing wire of $10,000 or more. Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $15 per account in a calendar year.
